title: Jorjani's great aunt talking with dead relatives on her deathbed
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Jorjani's great aunt talking with dead relatives on her deathbed, about unspecified at hospital room, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one case was my great aunt or I was there while she was like describing to not just not describing she was having conversations with dead relatives

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he was in a hospital room with his great aunt as she was dying. He says she was not just describing dead relatives but actually holding conversations with them. If true, it would hint that the dying can somehow reach those who have already died.
